snippet.title: Level 1 Complete! But It Wasn’t Easy... 👀🔥 #FiveFoldFury  #indiegame #gaming #platformer #gameplay
snippet.description:
🎮 Welcome to **FiveFoldFury** – a brutally challenging rage platformer with only 5 levels... but each one is designed to push you to your limits.

🧠 No jumping. No hand-holding. Just pure skill, timing, and determination. Think you’ve got what it takes?

📲 Download Now:
→ Google Play: http://bit.ly/4037uHw  
→ App Store: http://bit.ly/3GlUohW
